comment: The four signal inputs and the four outputs get no family: the module carries whatever is patched into it. It is mono in this build; the polyphonic pass-through in the maker's repository was added after 2.4.1. The input indices are interleaved with the control indices: 5, 9, 13 and 17 are the four signal inputs and the rest are the map controls, so the index order has nothing to do with the panel columns. An output is only written while its mapped input has a cable in it (Knot.cpp), so it holds its last value when that input is unpatched. Match cable colors lives on the widget rather than the module and is not written to the patch, so it comes back on every time.
